children: Uber completed a €4.5 billion registered offering of senior unsecured notes across five maturities.
The notes are senior unsecured debt issued under the company’s Form S-3 registration and related prospectus supplement.
Underwriters included Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank, Merrill Lynch International and BNP Paribas as representatives.
Net proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes; issuance governed by the Indenture and Third Supplemental Indenture dated Sept 15, 2026.
